title: Subscription Cancellation Proof Locker
oneLiner: A consumer receipt vault that turns hidden cancellation paths, chats, emails, and recurring charges into refund-ready proof.
targetUser: Consumers, parents managing household subscriptions, cord-cutters, app subscribers, and people trying to stop recurring charges without losing evidence.
keyUx: Enter a subscription, signup channel, charge history, renewal date, cancellation steps, screenshots, support chats, and card-dispute status; build a timeline, detect dark-pattern friction, store proof, draft refund requests, and remind users to verify the next statement.
stitchPrompt: Design a calm consumer finance product called Subscription Cancellation Proof Locker for consumers, parents managing household subscriptions, cord-cutters, app subscribers, and people trying to stop recurring charges without losing evidence. Users should enter a subscription, signup channel, charge history, renewal date, cancellation steps, screenshots, support chats, and card-dispute status, then build a timeline, detect dark-pattern friction, store proof, draft refund requests, and remind users to verify the next bank or card statement. Include a subscription intake, cancellation journey timeline, screenshot and chat evidence vault, renewal and statement watchlist, refund request composer, card-dispute packet, and household recurring-charge map. Design direction: use a calm-consumer aesthetic with soft money-saving colors, friendly progress steps, large renewal dates, reassuring evidence cards, and plain-language refund scripts so the product feels like a patient financial advocate, not a hostile chargeback console.
